Lioness Spotted on Istanbul Outskirts Sparks Search

Authorities in Istanbul, Turkey, are conducting a search for a lioness that was sighted on the city's outskirts. A resident reported seeing the animal on Sunday evening in Uskumrukoy, a neighborhood on the European side of Istanbul known for its surrounding forests. Police and animal welfare teams are involved in the operation.
